svg.title: Model card versus system card
svg.desc: Two panels. Left, a model card documents the model itself: its training data, its evaluations broken down by group, its intended and out-of-scope uses, and its known limitations. Right, a system card documents the deployed system, in which the model is one component in a pipeline from user input through filters, retrieval, and tools to the response, surrounded by monitoring, human oversight, policies, and deployment risks.

g.text: Model card: what the model is
benchmarks, results broken down by group
who it is for, and out-of-scope uses
System card: how the deployed system behaves
jailbreak rate, refusals, red-team findings, incidents
Written by whoever runs the system
